column1: # Stamp plate key → artwork source. Keys must match market/src/expansion-stamps.js.
# pokeapi:<pokemon> = silhouette of that Pokémon's official artwork (PokeAPI sprites).
# pokeapi-home:<pokemon> = the Pokémon HOME render, for poses that break apart at 40px.
# draw:<shape> = drawn here (no Pokémon on the stamp).
